notes: STAGE 1 OF 4: QUICK CUT. Mon 26 Oct 2026 to Sun 14 Mar 2027, 20 weeks: 16 cutting weeks plus reset weeks 5, 10, 15 and 20. Start from the true baseline: 90.8 kg and 28.5% body fat (11 Sep). Expect about 0.65 kg a week in cutting weeks, about 10 kg total, ending near 80–81 kg and 20–21% body fat. Roadmap. Stage 2, from 15 Mar: decision gate. If body fat is 16% or lower, do an 8-week clean bulk. If not (the likely case), do 4 weeks at maintenance and go straight to stage 3. Stage 3: final cut, ending mid-July 2027, about 12% body fat. Stage 4: hold with a small deficit or maintenance through the end of summer, aiming for 10–11%. A surplus bulk before the final cut costs about 8 weeks plus 4 to 5 extra cutting weeks, so it would not fit before mid-July from this starting point. Decide at the gate. Rules. 1) Three gym days: Sat, Mon, Wed. Two is a pass. Never make up a session. 2) One plan, same food every day. Everything is weighed and counted, coffee included. Tick every meal every day, including bad days. Logging stopped after 5 Oct, and that was the first sign. 3) Cardio is planned: 15 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift. Nothing else counts. Daily steps stay around 2,000. 4) Sleep 7 hours or more. 5) One planned flex meal a week, Friday dinner only. 6) Craving at night: water or Coke Zero, then wait 20 minutes. If still hungry, eat the next planned meal early; do not add extra food. 7) Weigh every morning; judge the 7-day average, not the day. Weeks 1 and 2 can read 1 kg or more lower from water. After that aim for 0.5–0.8 kg a week. 8) If the 7-day average falls less than 0.35 kg a week for 2 cutting weeks in a row after week 3, add one 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday. Only if that is not enough, take afternoon almonds out (10 g to 0). 9) If it falls more than 1 kg a week for 2 weeks in a row after week 3, add 100 g cooked rice to dinner. 10) If energy is 2 out of 5 or lower, or hunger is 4 out of 5 or higher, on 3 days in one week, take a reset week early instead of skipping sessions.

diet.name: Stage 1 quick cut — Kayy oats, Dina cottage cheese, one plan every day
diet.notes: One plan, same food every day, no carb cycling. Everything is counted, coffee and sugar included: 1747 kcal, protein 187 g, carbs 156 g, fat 37 g (about 43% protein, 36% carbs, 19% fat). Weigh dry oats before cooking; weigh chicken, rice and vegetables cooked. Values used: Kayy high protein oats 372 kcal, 30 g protein, 61 g carbs, 1 g fat per 100 g (pack label as listed online). Dina Farms cottage cheese is ASSUMED at 100 kcal, 12 g protein, 3.5 g carbs, 4 g fat per 100 g because no label is published online. Check your tub and correct the plan if it differs. Coke Zero is free. One Red Bull Zero on gym days replaces coffee 2. Spray oil: 6 spritzes a day, not counted. Anything not written here is not eaten. Do not drop below this plan. Reset weeks (5, 10, 15, 20): add oats 40 g to breakfast, one extra small banana in the afternoon, and rice 150 g cooked to dinner. That is about +430 kcal a day, close to maintenance. Friday dinner may be replaced by one planned flex meal of up to about 900 kcal, protein first, one plate, no leftovers.

training.name: Stage 1 — 3-day full body (Sat / Mon / Wed)
training.notes: Three evenings: Saturday, Monday, Wednesday. Sun, Tue, Thu, Fri are rest. A week with 2 sessions is a pass. A week with 3 is a good week. Never make up a missed session and never stack two sessions in a day. If Saturday is missed, Monday is the first session. If two sessions are missed in one week, do not change the plan; just do the next scheduled session. Every session is about 18–19 sets, 60 minutes of lifting plus the 15-minute walk. Stop every set with 1–2 reps in the tank. Hold the load until every set reaches the top of the rep range, then add 2.5–5 kg. Week 1 is a re-entry week after the break: 3 sets on the big lifts at the lighter weights written in the notes. Weeks 5, 10, 15 and 20 are reset weeks: 2 sets per exercise, same weights, and more food (see the diet notes). Cardio is planned, not left to chance: 15 minutes of easy incline walking after each lift, 3 times a week. You only walk between home, work, and the gym, so daily steps stay around 2,000 and are not part of the plan. If the 7-day average stalls after week 3, the first lever is one extra 30-minute easy cardio visit on Thursday, before any food is cut.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.notes: Top set 120 kg until you hit 6–7. Leave 1–2 reps in the tank. Week 1 only: 3 sets at about 105 kg.

exercises.name: Barbell bench press
exercises.notes: Hold 80 kg until every set is 6–7. Week 1 only: 3 sets at 72.5 kg.

exercises.name: Chest supported row
exercises.notes: 70 kg. Add reps toward 10, then add 2.5–5 kg.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.notes: 65–75 kg. All 3 sets at 10–12 before any jump in weight.

exercises.name: Incline walk finisher
exercises.notes: Planned cardio. Easy incline, a pace where you can talk, 15 minutes after the last lift. It is the only cardio in the week and it is counted in the plan. Skip it only if you were too flat to start the session.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.notes: 70 kg until you hit 9–10 on every set, then +5 kg.

exercises.name: Leg press
